results.prompt: Read the contents of docs/README.md.
Open reports/baseline.json and show its contents.
Read the ideas text file from the supplied file inventory. I only need its contents, not a directory listing.
Read inbox/Read Me.txt, preserving the spaces and capitalization in its path.
I need the plan for beta. The alpha plan is a distractor; read only the beta one from the inventory.
Read the JSON file in config whose name refers to runtime, rather than settings.
Show a recursive inventory of the entire workspace.
List all workspace file paths, including files in nested folders.
I do not need the contents of summary.txt. Show the complete workspace file inventory instead.
Which files are available anywhere in this workspace? Give me the full listing.
The projects folder is relevant later. For now, list all files across the whole workspace, not just project files.
Search file contents for the substring "latency".
Search inside file contents for the literal substring "baseline.json"; this is not a filename lookup.
Find occurrences of the complete phrase "meeting notes" inside file contents.
The words CPU and GPU occur in our discussion. Search file contents for the literal substring "CPU OR GPU", including the spaces and OR; do not treat OR as an operator or perform two searches.
Search text contents for the substring "2025-summary"; do not open the similarly named file.
Move notes/draft.txt to archive/draft.txt.
Move inbox/receipt.txt to archive/receipt.txt.
The old-results CSV in archive must stay where it is. Relocate the results CSV currently under reports to archive/results.csv.
Move inbox/Read Me.txt to archive/Read Me.txt. Keep its capitalization and spaces.
Rename notes/todo.txt to notes/tasks.txt. Keep the same directory and do not alter its contents.
Read the file for me.
Read meeting-notes.txt.
Move inbox/transfer.txt.
Search the workspace files.
Delete notes/draft.txt permanently.
Create notes/new.txt containing hello.
Move budget.csv to archive/budget.csv.
Eventually I want a complete workspace inventory. Before that, read the setup Markdown document under docs. Return only the first action.
Read reports/summary.txt after first listing all files in the workspace. Return only the first action.
Before choosing any file to read, search file contents for the literal substring "throughput". Do not substitute "latency". Return only the first action.
The receipt must stay in inbox. Move the transfer text file from inbox to archive/transfer.txt, then list all workspace files. Return only the first action.
Move notes/draft.txt to archive/draft.txt, but keep notes/draft.txt in its original location too. Do not change either requirement.
Move inbox/summary.txt to reports/summary.txt without replacing any existing file.
Read the CSV sample under data; the JSON sample is not the one I want.
Retrieve the contents of reports/latency.csv.
Show the text of docs/guide-français.md.
results.output_text: The text of docs/guide-français.md is not available here. Please check the documents folder.

results.prompt: Read the meeting text file whose basename contains "(final)" in the inventory, not either meeting-notes file.
Display a sorted inventory covering all workspace files and subfolders, without opening file contents.
I may inspect the samples later. Right now show every file path in the workspace, including directories nested under projects.
Look inside the files for the exact substring "tokens/s".
Find content matches using "memory footprint" as the complete substring query.
Both projects have a budget. Move only the alpha budget to archive/alpha-budget.csv; leave beta untouched.
Move the PNG file under assets to archive/photo.png. Leave the SVG where it is.
Open plan.md.
Move a file to archive/chosen.txt.
Append the line "Review complete" to notes/ideas.txt.
